data: Apple's operating income rose from $114,301 million in fiscal 2023 (year ended September 30, 2023) to $133,050 million in fiscal 2025 (year ended September 27, 2025). That is an increase of $18,749 million, or about 16.4%. For context, fiscal 2024 operating income was $123,216 million, so the gain came in two steps: roughly 7.8% from 2023 to 2024 and roughly 8.0% from 2024 to 2025.
